description.en: Toggles "warp" mode for a character, making its next position change (e.g. via CMND_SET_POSRY) apply instantly instead of being interpolated.
True to enable instant warp positioning.
Always 0 once applied; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments).

example.code:
// Enable instant warp positioning for a character
CMND_CHR_WARP_SET(hTenmaL, true);
